# Mudah (llms.txt)

TypeScript CLI/TUI framework. ESM. Node >= 26. Zero default runtime deps.

## Install

`@mudah-cli/mudah` is the umbrella. TUI: `@mudah-cli/mudah/tui`. Tests: `@mudah-cli/mudah/testing`.

## CLI

Commands: one file, default export, `signature` string `{arg?} [--flag]`. Groups: `db:status`.
`Command.handle()` returns an exit code. `this.arg` / `this.option` / `this.output`.
Prompts: `this.select` / `this.confirm` / `this.password`. Not a Program.
Tests: `TestApp.create({ cwd }).dispatch(['cmd']).exit(0).outContains('...')`.

Built-ins include `make`, `doctor`, `tutorial`, `docs:widgets`, `lsp`, `replay`,
`test`, `storybook`, `watch` (dev wrapper), `dev`.

## TUI: one way

Depth: flags/JSON → Command. One question → prompt. Full-screen → Program.

```ts
import { Program, Screen, Column, Row, Split } from '@mudah-cli/mudah/tui';
import { TestTui } from '@mudah-cli/mudah/testing';

const screen = Screen.picker({ title: 'Env', items: ['staging', 'prod'] });
const program = new Program();
screen.attach(program);
await program.run();
screen.result();
```

Recipes first: `Screen.picker`, `Screen.wizard`, `Screen.dashboard`. Then `Form.fromSchema(s.object({...}))`. Custom `BaseComponent` last.

Layout: `Column` (vertical), `Row` (horizontal), `Split` (two panes, drag bar). `Container` is a Column. No flex. No CSS.

`Program.mount(layout)` then `run()`. Escape quits unless Overlay consumes it. ctrl+c = 130.

## Widgets

Label, Panel, List (click + arrows), MultiList, Table, Viewport, TextInput (caret, paste).
Chrome: StatusBar, HelpFooter, Hyperlink (OSC 8), Image (Kitty or half-blocks).
Nav: Stack (push/pop), Overlay (modal, toast, ctrl+k palette).
Extra: Sparkline, Tree, FuzzyList, Toolbar, Pager.

Leftover space goes to children that implement `resize` (Viewport, Table, Panel, nested layouts).

### Constructor options

| Widget | options |
| --- | --- |
| List | `items: string[]`, `onSelect?(index)` |
| Table | `columns: {header, align?, width?}[]`, `rows: string[][]`, `onSelect?(index, row)`, `viewportHeight?` |
| TextInput | `onSubmit?(value)`, then `width`, `value`, `cursor`, `onChange` |
| Toolbar | `{ items: {id, label, icon?, shortcut?, onSelect?}[], onSelect?(id), name? }` |
| Pager | `{ lines: string[], title? }` — `/` search, `g`/`G` jump |
| Form | `Form.fromSchema(schema, title?)` — schema is `s.object({...})` |
| Screen.picker | `{ title?, items }` |
| Screen.wizard | `{ title?, steps: {name, kind: pick\|multi\|text, items?, label?}[] }` |
| Screen.dashboard | `{ title?, sidebar?, columns, rows, ratio? }` |
| Screen.form | `{ title?, schema }` |
| Screen.table | `{ title?, columns, rows, select? }` |
| Screen.tree | `{ title?, nodes }` |
| TestTui | `TestTui.mount(root, { cols?, rows?, snapshotDir? })` |

`widgetReference()` instantiates built-ins and returns `{ role, options }[]` from `inspect()`. See `packages/tui/WIDGETS.md`. `docs:widgets` prints it.

## TestTui

```ts
const tui = TestTui.mount(screen.root, { cols: 80, rows: 24 });
tui.send('down').send('enter').click(2, 3).paste('hi');
tui.snapshot(); // ASCII
tui.tree();     // JSON { role, name, value, focused, bounds, children }
```

`SessionRecorder` `{ record(action), dump(), tape(), replay(tui) }` — no PTY. Timed replay: `replayTapeAsync`.
`fromLayout` / `parseLayout` / `compileLayout` (`column|row|split|label|list|panel|checkbox|progress`).
`VideoPlayer` (half-block / Kitty, pause/seek). `LayoutDebugger` overlay.
`renderWidgetToText` / `renderWidgetToHtml` — headless, no process I/O. Import
`@mudah-cli/tui/wasi` (alias `@mudah-cli/tui/headless`) to skip Program.

No PTY. No Ink. No Blessed. No raw `\x1b[` in app code.

## Scaffold

`make tui picker|wizard|dashboard`
`make command name` / `make provider name` / `make config name` / `make plugin name`
`doctor` prints a TUI dump sample.
`tutorial` — create app, make command, TestTui, doctor (prints when non-TTY / `--plain`).

## VS Code

TextMate grammar for `*.command.ts`: `.vscode/mudah.tmLanguage.json` (highlights `signature`, `description`, `handle`). Contributed from `.vscode/package.json`. `files.associations` in `.vscode/settings.json`.

## Forbidden

Screen.* and TestTui exist. Do not invent Ink, Blessed, React-in-terminal, or a fourth layout system.
